messages:
Maya (CSM): Hey team — kicking off BlueBloom onboarding. Quick ask: confirm primary technical & business stakeholders, top 3 success criteria, and whether we can hit a P0 integration test by day 7. Intake: https://redwood.internal/onboard/BB-42
Liam (Solutions Eng): Primary tech = Dan, business = Sarah (BlueBloom PM). I'll own the integration plan. We can shoot for day 7 P0 smoke but need sample data + API keys by EOD Tue.
Ashley (Product): I'll own enablement + product walkthrough. Suggested success criteria:
  1) sandbox traffic ingested (end-to-end),
  2) p95 generation latency <100ms for sample prompt,
  3) basic RBAC/entitlements configured for BlueBloom team.
Dan (Integration Eng): I'll take infra tasks. Need API keys, CORS whitelist, and any IP allowlist. Will stand up a simple harness and a replay script. ETA depends on keys.
Maya (CSM): Sarah confirmed she'll provide keys and a data sample tomorrow morning. @Liam can you and Dan pair on the harness after keys land? Also @OnboardBot please create kickoff meeting Tue 10:00 AM PST.
OnboardBot: Meeting created: "BlueBloom — Redwood Onboarding Kickoff" Tue 10:00 AM PST. Invitees: Maya, Liam, Ashley, Dan, Sarah. Calendar link: https://calendar.redwood/meet/BB-kickoff
Dan (Integration Eng): Heads up — BlueBloom rotates API tokens every 24h. Risk: automated rotation will break our initial smoke unless we use a service account or implement rotation logic. Flagging as renewal-risk early because it impacts time-to-value.
Liam (Solutions Eng): :thumbsup: noted. Proposing a compact smoke-test checklist — will run after keys are live:
```
Smoke test checklist
- retrieve token from vault / verify expiry
- call /health -> expect 200
- generate sample prompt -> measure latency (target <100ms p95)
- verify trace shows request in Console and logs
- validate entitlements: user_x cannot access premium route
```
Maya (CSM): Thanks — plan of record:
- Maya: confirm stakeholders & client contacts by EOD today (I will DM Sarah to confirm CC list)
- Liam + Dan: draft smoke-test & harness by Tue EOD
- Ashley: prep 30-min product walkthrough + enablement doc ahead of Tue meeting
I'll follow up post-meeting with a 7-day timeline and weekly checkpoints. Any blockers? :rocket:
file_description: BlueBloom onboarding kickoff thread: stakeholders, success criteria, timeline, initial risks and smoke-test checklist
